title: Enable `dupl` linter
body: According to the discussion in containers/storage#1579, enable linter `dupl`, set the threshold to `200` and exclude tests from linting.

comments.body: For the record, this issue was filed against c/storage, the link is for c/common. (But, also, I don’t particularly care to be in the business of bike-shedding linter choices, so I’m not going to reopen this myself.)
Ah, maybe it would be worth using a shared config for linters?

Looking at https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/926 which enables the linter _and immediately nerfs it using `threshold: 200`_, making the whole exercise pointless, I just don’t think tinkering with this is a good use of time.
